items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Lawrence Duet. Lawrence Duet quit, went on scoreboard, he wanted the client to carry him down there. Put him in the band.

ctx.x: And carried him down there, because that's the time he, let me see, Oda had the launch, Lawrence. Lawrence Duet. Lawrence Duet quit, went on scoreboard, he wanted the client to carry him down there. Put him in the band.
Well, I'm not real sure I know just where you lived when you moved down. You said your mother worked uptown. Did you live there with her or was it?
